plugin.name: Install the converted Apocalypse plugin
plugin.description:
REPLACES "Apocalypse - Magic of Skyrim.esp" with an Enderal-converted version. This is not a patch loaded on top - it overwrites Enai's plugin file.
INSTALL ORDER 1. Install Apocalypse - Magic of Skyrim 10.2.3 by Enai Siaion first. Its two BSAs supply every mesh, texture, sound and script; this download contains none of them and cannot work without it. 2. Install this and LET IT OVERWRITE. 3. Keep "Apocalypse - Magic of Skyrim.esp" enabled, exactly where it already was. 4. If you used an earlier build of this mod, DELETE "Zenderal - Apocalypse.esp" - it no longer exists and will crash the game if left enabled.
Pinned to Apocalypse 10.2.3. A different version will not match and must not be used with this.
WHY A REPLACEMENT AND NOT A PATCH
Enderal runs on Skyrim SE 1.5.97, and that engine silently refuses to load any plugin whose header form version is 1.71 - no warning, no log entry, the plugin is just absent. Apocalypse is 1.71, so in Enderal it has never loaded at all. No patch can fix that from the outside, because a patch has to declare Apocalypse as a master and the engine has already skipped it. The plugin itself has to be rebuilt at form version 1.70.
WHAT ELSE CHANGED
Distribution: Apocalypse's own targets 54 vanilla Skyrim leveled lists, none of which exist in Enderal. Instead, all 160 spell tomes are stocked directly by six named merchants, ranked by their gold so the richest sells the master spells and the poorest the novice ones - Emberlord and Fireflash (Ark), Torius Flameling (Sun Temple), Barnabas (Undercity), Ora Stonehand (Ark), Maxus Tabbakus (Duneville), Milbert Foxhand (Ark). Every tome is buyable at exactly one shop. The 130 scrolls, and tomes again, are also added to Enderal's world-loot lists so they still turn up as finds.
Merchant stock only refreshes every two in-game days, so on an existing save give it 48 hours.
Pricing: every tome and scroll is rescaled onto Enderal's economy. Apocalypse prices on vanilla Skyrim's ladder, where a master tome is ~1300 gold; Enderal's entire spell tome range is 20-350. Tome medians become 45 / 95 / 180 / 280 / 395 for novice through master, and scrolls 15 / 30 / 60 / 125 / 250. It is a per-tier ratio, so Enai's own ordering within each tier is preserved. Magicka costs are untouched.
Arcane Fever: Enderal has no healing potions, so magical self-healing is the only heal and every one of Enderal's own raises Arcane Fever - at 100 you die of it. Apocalypse's heals cost nothing, which retires the mechanic outright. The 19 spells and scrolls that heal you now pay the same tax, at rates taken from Enderal's own healing spells, so nothing in Apocalypse is a more efficient heal than Enderal's best. Wild Healing costs 5, Breath of Tyr 5 to 19 depending on how long you channel it, King's Heart 12. Mental Expert reduces all of it by a third, as it does for Enderal's. Spells that heal by draining an enemy are deliberately left untaxed.
KNOWN CONFLICT - KataPUMB Spell Package
That mod adds the same 15 staves to three Enderal spell merchants: Emberlord and Fireflash, Torius Flameling, and Tarhutie in Riverville. This mod claims the first two, so those staves stop being sold there. Tarhutie is deliberately left untouched - the staff set is identical at all three shops, so all 15 stay buyable from him and nothing of KataPUMB's becomes unobtainable. That is why the Apprentice tier sits with Maxus Tabbakus rather than Tarhutie.
Dragonborn master removed entirely. The 67 staff-crafting recipes are deleted - they need a Staff Enchanter and Heart Stones, neither of which Enderal has - and the remaining DLC references are repointed. Enderal's own enchanter is untouched.
The Tamriel worldspace override is deleted. That record ID belongs to Enderal's prologue house, and Apocalypse was stamping Skyrim's map grid over it.
Summons removed as un-Enderal: the six Dremora, both Xivilai, Weeping Daedra, Lord of Bindings, Six Demon Bag, Herne, Kyrkrim, Atronach Mark and the Dwemer Craftlord. Their tomes are never distributed.
Renames: spells named after Elder Scrolls gods and mages become Enderal equivalents.
Fabricate Object drops its Staff Enchanter option, leaving the eight stations Enderal actually has.
An addon node index that collided with one of Enderal's own effects is moved.
All spells, assets and design are Enai Siaion's. Please endorse the original.
